    katica hegyi

    i am an architectural engineer from budapest, hungary. i earned my bsc in architectural engineering at óbuda university’s ybl miklós faculty in 2025, where my bachelor’s thesis received the kolbenheyer gyula prize. i then earned my msc in 2026 through the architectural design ecology in the digital age (made) programme at universitat politècnica de catalunya in barcelona.

    my interests centre on local, renewable and recycled materials, prefabricated and modular construction, and spaces that work with their environment. i explore how data analysis, programming, artificial intelligence and parametric design can support these ideas and inform architectural decisions.

    through K/ARC, my independent practice focuses on:

    • small-scale architectural projects
    • concept design and spatial studies
    • design research and environmental analysis
    • architectural visualisation and presentation
